source.normalization: Original pieces have unit circumradius, so dodecahedron edge length is 0.71364417954617976; centers divided by this edge. Apply a proper rigid rotation to align ALL published icosahedron outer vertices with the project canonical solid (normalized discrepancy 1.54e-15). Fit piece rotations to ALL source mesh vertices (maximum discrepancy 1.13e-15). Convert container circumradius into edge ratio R/(0.95105651629515353 * 0.71364417954617976). Add standard 1e-7 clearance without transferring discovery credit.
